description: Source code for MediaEngineRMF plugin implementing media playback control, event handling, and initialization within the WPEFramework platform.

classes.name: MediaEngineRMF
classes.description: Main class implementing media engine plugin with methods for media control, event handling, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: initialize_player
methods.description: Initializes the media platform support for 'qam' source type, setting environment variables and calling mediaplayer::initialize.

methods.name: deinitialize_player
methods.description: Deinitializes the 'qam' media platform support by calling mediaplayer::deinitialize.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Creates and starts media playback for a given 'qam' source identifier.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback and resets the media player.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the media player.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level of the media player.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video display rectangle parameters.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles media events and sends notifications.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles error events and sends notifications.
